newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia welcomes Mexico wool tariff removal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia welcomes Mexico wool tariff removal.

text.p: Australian Trade Minister Tim Fischer said on Wednesday he welcomed Mexico's decision to eliminate tariffs on wool tops, noils and waste.

Fischer said in a statement the decision to remove the 10 percent tariffs from noils, the short pieces combed out of the wool once it has been clipped, and wool waste demonstrated the effectiveness of the government's bilateral trade talks.
Mexico decided to remove tariffs from wool tops last year.
"I warmly welcome the decision, which completes a successful period of negotiations aimed at reducing Mexican tariffs on a range of wool products of interest to Australian growers," Fischer said.

"It is an important step in developing what is shaping up as a productive strategic partnership between Australian wool producers and the wool textiles industry in Mexico, which will generate benefits for both countries," he said.
